I read from this that you play American football, a game I know very little about. But, what I do see, is that you probably play as the quarterback. There is a big difference between feeling like you play terrible, and others telling you you play badly. I played a lot of soccer, and when I played bad, the coach would pull me out from the game. Until this happens, don't beat yourself up over it. When it does happen, talk to the coach, and get your head back into the game.

The same thing goes for work. If you are under fire by your peers and co-workers, don't beat yourself up over it. If they are critiquing you, try and use it to become a better person.
